_comment: Properties of the default object of a VI Server class, the object a Property Node uses when its reference input is unwired. Entries are keyed by the property code path (the codes of the property's segments joined by '.'), because a Property Node row stores either the short or the long name. 'name' is NI's name for the property. A property is listed only when NI's public documentation says what its value is and that value is available to a Python process. 'python' is the expression generated code reads in place of the property; '{function}' is the name of the function the VI generates and '{callees}' a tuple of the functions of the VIs it calls; 'imports' are the statements the expression needs.
